source.title: Parisa - Ode to Flowers
source.name: Parisa
source.description: An elegant mage who enhances her own ATK SPD and that of her allies, she's especially powerful at taking down grouped enemies.

skills.name: Floral Splendor

description.raw: Parisa marks a non-marked enemy with a flower until the battle ends, dealing 480% (ATK-based) damage to all floral-marked targets and other enemies within 1 tiles of them. If the skill hits the targets multiple times within 2s, the subsequent damage dealt by targets is reduced by 20%.
active: Parisa marks a non-marked enemy with a flower until the battle ends, dealing 480% (ATK-based) damage to all floral-marked targets and other enemies within 1 tiles of them.
If the skill hits the targets multiple times within 2s, the subsequent damage dealt by targets is reduced by 20%.

text: Each defeated enemy who carries Floral Mark grants Parisa 60 + 20 (SP-based) Energy recovery per second in 5s.

skills.description_lite: Parisa marks a target with a flower and deals AoE damage to them.

skills.name: Floral Inspiration

description.raw: Parisa increases ATK SPD by 22 + 3 (SP-based) and normal attack damage by 22% for 10s for herself and 1 nearest ally.
active: Parisa increases ATK SPD by 22 + 3 (SP-based) and normal attack damage by 22% for 10s for herself and 1 nearest ally.

text: Increases ATK SPD by 25 + 3 (SP-based), and the normal attack damage by 25%.
Increases ATK SPD by 28 + 3 (SP-based), and the normal attack damage by 28%.
Increases ATK SPD by 30 + 3 (SP-based), and the normal attack damage by 30%.

skills.description_lite: Parisa increases ATK SPD and normal attack damage for herself an an ally.

skills.name: Flower Power

description.raw: After every 3 normal attacks, Parisa launches a bouquet of flowers that gradually expands towards her target, dealing 200% (ATK-based) + 20% (SP-based) damage to all enemies along the path. Each enemy hit by flowers restores herself an extra 70 Energy. Every bouquet of flowers can recover her Energy up to 3 times.
active: After every 3 normal attacks, Parisa launches a bouquet of flowers that gradually expands towards her target, dealing 200% (ATK-based) + 20% (SP-based) damage to all enemies along the path.
Each enemy hit by flowers restores herself an extra 70 Energy.
Every bouquet of flowers can recover her Energy up to 3 times.

skills.description_lite: Parisa shoots flowers to attack enemies along the path after a number of normal attacks.

description.raw: Parisa marks the nearest enemy in a symmetrical position with a flower when a battle starts.
active: Parisa marks the nearest enemy in a symmetrical position with a flower when a battle starts.

text: Normal attacks hit 1 more target after inflicting 4 marks.
Normal attacks hit 1 more target after inflicting 3 marks.
Normal attacks hit 1 more target after inflicting 2 marks.

skills.name: Enhance Force

description.raw: Reduces the required normal attacks to trigger Flower Power by 1.
active: Reduces the required normal attacks to trigger Flower Power by 1.

skills.description_lite: Parisa triggers Flower Power with fewer normal attacks.
